text:
omar: heads up — found a case where billing admins can fetch org-level usage via the /v2/analytics endpoint even when our RBAC policy should block 'read_usage'. repro steps below.

omar: repro: 1) create role 'billing_viewer' without read_usage, 2) issue token for user in that role, 3) call POST /v2/analytics/query -> 200 + full org usage payload.

omar: request (sanitized):

```
POST /v2/analytics/query HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer token_xxx
Content-Type: application/json
{ "range": "30d", "group_by": ["team"] }
```

omar: response: 200 OK with JSON body containing per-org token/usage rows. headers show `x-service-role: billing-admin` which is wrong — token should not have that scope.

sara: ack. do we have gateway logs or policy eval traces? can you paste the policy id it matched?

omar: attaching excerpt from gateway trace: `policy_eval_id=pe-9f4a` — eval returned allow because `role_mapping` returned `admin` for that token. suspect mapping code uses `roles` claim fallback.

lee: sounds like a role-claim parsing bug. we recently changed token format to embed both `roles` and `grants` claims. gateway mapping reads `roles` only and treats missing as admin.

ana (typo corrected to ana): can we 1) block analytics endpoint in the router until we patch, 2) create an audit-only rule to capture any read_usage hits, 3) make a hotfix so tokens with no explicit `read_usage` are rejected for org-level queries?

mike: i'll open a PR to add an explicit permission gate in the router (enforce: has_permission('read_usage')). will link.

mike: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/+/I1234 — adds check in analytics proxy and a feature-flag for gradual rollout.

lee: also make sure our policy evaluator doesn't default to allow when claim parsing fails. default must be deny.

omar: noticed something else: KMS audit logs for the service-account that minted the token are missing for those requests. i can see token issuance events but no KMS decrypt entries around the same timestamp.

security-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-45 — "Analytics endpoint authorization bypass for billing tokens". Severity: P2. Assigned: eng-security + eng-platform.

ana (ana): triage notes: probable cause - token parsing fallback + router gate missing. Impact - a subset of billing admins (and mis-minted tokens) could read org-level usage (cost data). Exposure window unknown, need to scan access logs for last 90 days.

lee: plan: (1) hotfix router gate and force deny, deploy to staging within 2 hours, (2) backfill audit logs and run query for suspicious tokens, (3) add unit tests for claim parsing and e2e with mocked tokens, (4) release to prod with canary.

omar: example audit query (stackdriver) to find suspicious calls:

```
resource.type="k8s_container"
logName="projects/redwood-prod/logs/analytics_gateway"
jsonPayload.endpoint="/v2/analytics/query"
jsonPayload.response_code=200
jsonPayload.principal.role!="billing_admin_expected"
"token_xxx" OR jsonPayload.request_body:"org_id"
timestamp >= "2025-11-01T00:00:00Z"
```

sara: good. i'll run the query and post findings. also add a BigQuery export run to generate per-token access summary for last 90 days.

mike: patch ready, linking staging deploy: https://deploys.redwood/status/gradual/5678. will flip feature-flag once e2e green.

lee: follow-up: add an RBAC regression test in CI that exercises cross-claim permutations (`roles`, `grants`, `scopes`) so we don't regress when token shape evolves.

omar: note for compliance: we need to surface this to SOC and update control docs. missing KMS audit entries may trigger extra review — i'm starting a KMS integrity check run.

security-bot: Update: INC-2026-45 status -> investigation. Tags: rbac, analytics, kms, audit-logs.

ana (ana): timeline: patch -> staging in 2h, smoke passing -> prod deploy 10:00 UTC tomorrow. owner: mike (router fix), lee (evaluator tests), sara (log scan), omar (KMS audit).

omar: OK — i'll also rotate any suspect tokens and issue a notice to infra keys team if KMS correlation remains missing.

deploy-bot: Deploy I1234 to staging started by mike at 1763456825.

mike: staging deploy passed smoke, e2e failing on one flake, rerunning.

lee: thanks everyone. keep updates here; if we find any confirmed exfiltration of cost data, escalate to P1 and page oncall. :eyes:
